title: Super Mario Galaxy
shortDescription: A gravity-bending platformer built from compact worlds, inventive movement, and a steady stream of surprising spatial ideas.
highlights: Small planetoids turn gravity into a constant level-design tool
A generous challenge curve makes experimentation feel safe

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A Wii design landmark that makes its platform’s pointer and motion affordances feel additive without letting them obscure precise movement.
